```{r helper_func, include=FALSE}
std_to_ref <- function(x, ref, sign = 1) {
  m  <- mean(ref, na.rm = TRUE)
  s  <- sd(ref,   na.rm = TRUE)
  sign * (x - m) / s
}

# 4 rows per emmeans (~ g_t | dep) object: two distress levels × two g_t levels.
# CI only on treated bars, matching plot_heterogeneity.py::_plot_distress_community.
matt_het_bars_emm <- function(emm, stratum) {
  s <- as.data.frame(summary(emm, infer = TRUE))
  tibble(
    stratum   = stratum,
    dep_bsl   = factor(if_else(s$dep == 1,
                               "High baseline distress",
                               "Low baseline distress"),
                       levels = c("High baseline distress", "Low baseline distress")),
    condition = factor(if_else(s$g_t == 1, "Grad + Therapy", "Grad"),
                       levels = c("Grad", "Grad + Therapy")),
    y         = s$emmean,
    ci_lo     = if_else(s$g_t == 1, s$lower.CL, NA_real_),
    ci_hi     = if_else(s$g_t == 1, s$upper.CL, NA_real_)
  )
}

run_mech_models <- function(dvs, data,
                            controls = c("kessler_6_bsl","female_head",
                                         "someprimary_head", "somesecondary_head",
                                         "hhsize", "coh1_holdout"),
                            fe       = "c2_vil_clus_id",
                            label    = NA_character_) {

  out <- map_dfr(dvs, function(dv) {

    f <- reformulate(c("g_t", controls, sprintf("factor(%s)", fe)), response = dv)
    m <- lm_robust(f, data = data, se_type = "HC1")

    row <- tidy(m) %>% filter(term == "g_t")

    keep   <- complete.cases(data[c(dv, "g_t", controls, fe)])
    sd_ref <- sd(data[[dv]][keep & data$g_t == 0], na.rm = TRUE)

    tibble(
      sample    = label,
      dv        = dv,
      estimate  = row$estimate,
      se        = row$std.error,
      ci_low    = row$conf.low,
      ci_high   = row$conf.high,
      p         = row$p.value,
      N         = m$nobs,
      sd_noGIPT = sd_ref,
      est_sd    = row$estimate / sd_ref
    )
  })

  out %>% mutate(p_fdr = p.adjust(p, method = "BH"), .after = p)
}

run_mech_predictors <- function(mechs, data,
                                outcome  = "psych_distress_index",
                                lag      = "kessler_6_bsl",
                                controls = c("female_head", "someprimary_head",
                                             "somesecondary_head", "hhsize", "coh1_holdout"),
                                fe       = "c2_vil_clus_id",
                                label    = NA_character_) {

  out <- map_dfr(mechs, function(mech) {

    f <- reformulate(c(mech, lag, controls, sprintf("factor(%s)", fe)),
                     response = outcome)
    m <- lm_robust(f, data = data, se_type = "HC1")

    row <- tidy(m) %>% filter(term == mech)
    if (nrow(row) != 1L) stop("term not found in fit: ", mech)

    tibble(
      sample   = label,
      outcome  = outcome,
      dv       = mech,
      estimate = row$estimate,
      se       = row$std.error,
      ci_low   = row$conf.low,
      ci_high  = row$conf.high,
      p        = row$p.value,
      N        = m$nobs
    )
  })

  out %>% mutate(p_fdr = p.adjust(p, method = "BH"), .after = p)
}

# Two rows per emmeans object (control + treated). CI only on treated,
# matching Matt's Python (`plot_panels.py::_plot_overall_panel`).
matt_bars_emm <- function(emm, outcome, stratum) {
  s <- as.data.frame(summary(emm, infer = TRUE))
  tibble(
    outcome   = outcome,
    stratum   = stratum,
    condition = factor(c("Grad", "Grad + Therapy"),
                       levels = c("Grad", "Grad + Therapy")),
    y         = c(s$emmean[s$g_t == 0], s$emmean[s$g_t == 1]),
    ci_lo     = c(NA_real_, s$lower.CL[s$g_t == 1]),
    ci_hi     = c(NA_real_, s$upper.CL[s$g_t == 1])
  )
}

# Extract both bars (control + treated) from an emmeans object; CI only on
# the Group Therapy bar (control CIs returned as NA so no whisker draws).
emm_to_bars <- function(emm, sample, timepoint) {
  s <- as.data.frame(summary(emm, infer = TRUE))
  tibble(
    sample    = sample,
    timepoint = timepoint,
    condition = factor(if_else(s$g_t == 1, "Group Therapy", "Control"),
                       levels = c("Control", "Group Therapy")),
    y         = s$emmean,
    ci_lo     = if_else(s$g_t == 1, s$lower.CL, NA_real_),
    ci_hi     = if_else(s$g_t == 1, s$upper.CL, NA_real_)
  )
}

# Same shape as `emm_to_bars`, but 95% CI whiskers on BOTH bars
# (control + treated). Use for panels where both conditions get CIs.
# `p_te` is the p-value of the g_t == 1 minus g_t == 0 contrast, repeated
# on both rows so it can be filtered later for a single significance sign.
emm_to_bars_both_ci <- function(emm, sample, timepoint) {
  s  <- as.data.frame(summary(emm, infer = TRUE))
  ct <- contrast(emm, method = list("gipt_vs_ctrl" = c(-1, 1)))
  te_p <- as.data.frame(summary(ct, infer = TRUE))$p.value[1]
  tibble(
    sample    = sample,
    timepoint = timepoint,
    condition = factor(if_else(s$g_t == 1, "Group Therapy", "Control"),
                       levels = c("Control", "Group Therapy")),
    y         = s$emmean,
    ci_lo     = s$lower.CL,
    ci_hi     = s$upper.CL,
    p_te      = te_p
  )
}

# Fit a single TE `emmeans` object for a given outcome + data slice.
# Uses the psych-panel baseline set: `kessler_6_bsl` + household covariates
# + village fixed effects, HC1 SEs. Convenience wrapper to keep the
# Panel B / C / D models chunks compact.
fit_te_emm <- function(outcome_var, data) {
  form <- reformulate(
    c("g_t", "kessler_6_bsl", "female_head", "someprimary_head",
      "somesecondary_head", "hhsize", "coh1_holdout",
      "factor(c2_vil_clus_id)"),
    response = outcome_var
  )
  m <- lm_robust(form, se_type = "HC1", data = data)
  emmeans(m, ~ g_t, at = list(g_t = c(0, 1)))
}

# Extract the g_t == 1 minus g_t == 0 contrast (treatment effect) from an
# emmeans object, plus its 95% CI and p-value. Returns ONE row per call.
emm_to_te <- function(emm, sample, timepoint) {
  ct <- contrast(emm, method = list("gipt_vs_ctrl" = c(-1, 1)))
  s  <- as.data.frame(summary(ct, infer = TRUE))
  tibble(
    sample    = sample,
    timepoint = timepoint,
    y         = s$estimate,
    ci_lo     = s$lower.CL,
    ci_hi     = s$upper.CL,
    p         = s$p.value
  )
}

# Same idea as emm_to_te(), but for a g_t × dep interaction model. Assumes
# `emm` was built with `~ g_t | dep, at = list(g_t = c(0,1), dep = c(0,1))`.
# Returns TWO rows (one TE per baseline-distress level).
emm_to_te_by_dep <- function(emm, sample, timepoint) {
  ct <- contrast(emm, method = "revpairwise")
  s  <- as.data.frame(summary(ct, infer = TRUE))
  tibble(
    sample    = sample,
    timepoint = timepoint,
    dep_bsl   = factor(if_else(s$dep == 1, "High", "Low"),
                       levels = c("High", "Low")),
    y         = s$estimate,
    ci_lo     = s$lower.CL,
    ci_hi     = s$upper.CL,
    p         = s$p.value
  )
}

# Significance sign for a treatment-effect p-value.
#   p < .05 -> "*"     p < .10 -> "†" (dagger, U+2020)     otherwise -> ""
# NB: `sig_sign()` feeds plain `geom_text()` in Figures 3/4/5, which does NOT
# parse HTML — so the dagger has to be a raw unicode character, not
# "<sup>†</sup>". The mechanism panels (below) that use `geom_richtext` build
# their sig marks in a separate `stars` block and can keep the <sup> wrapping.
sig_sign <- function(p) dplyr::case_when(
  is.na(p) ~ "",
  p < 0.001 ~ "***",
  p < 0.01 ~ "**",
  p < 0.05 ~ "*",
  p < 0.10 ~ "†",
  TRUE     ~ ""
)

# Strip each panel's own caption so only the shared plot_annotation caption
# renders at the bottom of the combined figure.
strip_caption <- function(p) p + labs(caption = NULL)

# Extract 4 rows (g_t × dep) from an emmeans object plus a time-point tag.
# `p_te` is the p-value of the g_t == 1 minus g_t == 0 contrast computed
# WITHIN each dep level (so it differs between High and Low). Same p_te
# on both rows within a (time_point, dep_bsl) pair so a downstream filter
# by condition can pull one label per (time_point, dep_bsl).
emm_to_k6_line_df <- function(emm, time_point) {
  s <- as.data.frame(summary(emm, infer = TRUE))
  # TE per dep level via revpairwise on g_t within each dep
  te   <- contrast(emm, method = "revpairwise", by = "dep")
  te_s <- as.data.frame(summary(te, infer = TRUE))
  p_te_map <- setNames(te_s$p.value, as.character(te_s$dep))
  tibble(
    time_point = time_point,
    condition  = factor(if_else(s$g_t == 1, "Group Therapy", "Control"),
                        levels = c("Control", "Group Therapy")),
    dep_bsl    = factor(if_else(s$dep == 1, "High", "Low"),
                        levels = c("High", "Low")),
    y          = s$emmean,
    ci_lo      = s$lower.CL,
    ci_hi      = s$upper.CL,
    p_te       = unname(p_te_map[as.character(s$dep)])
  )
}

# Extract 2 rows (g_t = 0, 1) from an emmeans object plus a time-point tag.
# `p_te` is the p-value of the g_t == 1 minus g_t == 0 contrast, repeated
# on both rows so a downstream filter by condition can pull one label
# per time_point for the significance sign.
emm_to_k6_line_nodep_df <- function(emm, time_point) {
  s <- as.data.frame(summary(emm, infer = TRUE))
  ct   <- contrast(emm, method = list("gipt_vs_ctrl" = c(-1, 1)))
  p_te <- as.data.frame(summary(ct, infer = TRUE))$p.value[1]
  tibble(
    time_point = time_point,
    condition  = factor(if_else(s$g_t == 1, "Group Therapy", "Control"),
                        levels = c("Control", "Group Therapy")),
    y          = s$emmean,
    ci_lo      = s$lower.CL,
    ci_hi      = s$upper.CL,
    p_te       = p_te
  )
}
```

# Figure 3 - Treatment Effect on Psychological Distress
## Panel A - `psych_distress_index`
```{r fig6_panelA_models, include=FALSE}
# Six models for panel A: psych_distress_index at 3m FU (STFU) and 20-month
# FU (endline), in the pooled sample plus the host / refugee subsamples.
# Specs mirror the regression Rmd:

#   Host    STFU  L1014-1023  Host    Endline L1352-1361
#   Refugee STFU  L1689-1697  Refugee Endline L2024-2033

psyInd_stfu_lm_rbst <-
  lm_robust(psych_distress_index ~ g_t + kessler_6_bsl +
```

```{r fig6_panelA}
# Treatment effect (g_t == 1 minus g_t == 0) per sample × timepoint, extracted
# via contrast(emm, list(c(-1, 1))). Bars show the TE with a 95% CI whisker.
fig6_panelA_df <- bind_rows(
  emm_to_te(psyInd_stfu_emm_rbst,     "Pooled",  "3m FU"),
  emm_to_te(psyInd_enl_emm_rbst,      "Pooled",  "20m FU"),
  emm_to_te(psyInd_hst_stfu_emm_rbst, "Host",    "3m FU"),
  emm_to_te(psyInd_hst_enl_emm_rbst,  "Host",    "20m FU"),
  emm_to_te(psyInd_ref_stfu_emm_rbst, "Refugee", "3m FU"),
  emm_to_te(psyInd_ref_enl_emm_rbst,  "Refugee", "20m FU")
) %>%
  mutate(
    sample    = factor(sample,    levels = c("Pooled", "Host", "Refugee")),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = c("3m FU", "20m FU")),
    # Same `bar_fill` levels as Panels B / C / D so `patchwork::plot_layout(
    # guides = "collect")` produces one shared legend downstream.  "Control"
    # is defined but unused in Panel A (TE plot has no control dot). Values
    # produced by case_when MUST match the levels vector exactly, otherwise
    # factor() coerces them to NA and the fill mapping breaks silently.
    bar_fill  = factor(case_when(
      timepoint == "3m FU"  ~ "Group Therapy (3m FU)",
      timepoint == "20m FU" ~ "Group Therapy (20m FU)"
    ),
    levels = c("Control",
               "Group Therapy (3m FU)",
               "Group Therapy (20m FU)"))
  )

fig6_panelA <-
  ggplot(fig6_panelA_df, aes(x = timepoint, y = y, fill = bar_fill)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4, colour = "grey40") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci_lo, ymax = ci_hi, color = timepoint),
                width = 0.15, linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 3.5, stroke = 0.4, colour = "black") +
  geom_text(aes(y = ci_hi, label = sig_sign(p)),
            vjust = -0.6, size = 5, colour = "black", show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-.12, .22), breaks = seq(-.1, .2, .1)) +
  facet_wrap(~ sample, ncol = 3) +
  # `values` keys are the DATA values (bar_fill levels); `labels` re-titles
  # them in the legend without breaking the colour mapping.
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Control"                = "grey70",
               "Group Therapy (3m FU)"  = "steelblue1",
               "Group Therapy (20m FU)" = "dodgerblue4"),
    labels = c("Control"                = "Graduation control",
               "Group Therapy (3m FU)"  = "Group therapy (3m FU)",
               "Group Therapy (20m FU)" = "Group therapy (20m FU)"),
    name   = NULL,
    drop   = FALSE  # keep the "Control" key visible in the collected legend
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Control"                = "grey70",
               "Group Therapy (3m FU)"  = "steelblue1",
               "Group Therapy (20m FU)" = "dodgerblue4"),
    labels = c("Control"                = "Graduation control",
               "Group Therapy (3m FU)"  = "Group therapy (3m FU)",
               "Group Therapy (20m FU)" = "Group therapy (20m FU)"),
    name   = NULL,
    drop   = FALSE  # keep the "Control" key visible in the collected legend
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Effect size \n(std. to Mean and SD of refugee Graduation control)",
       title = "Psychological Distress Index") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    legend.position    = "bottom",
    strip.text         = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0),
    axis.title.y       = element_text(size = 9, colour = "grey30"),
    plot.title.position = "plot"
  )

fig6_panelA
```

## Panel B - `kessler_10`

```{r fig6_panelB}
fig6_panelB_df <- bind_rows(
  emm_to_bars_both_ci(ksl10_stfu_emm_rbst,     "Pooled",  "3m FU"),
  emm_to_bars_both_ci(ksl10_enl_emm_rbst,      "Pooled",  "20m FU"),

    labels = c("Control"                = "Graduation control",
               "Group Therapy (3m FU)"  = "Group therapy (3m FU)",
               "Group Therapy (20m FU)" = "Group therapy (20m FU)"),
    name = NULL
  ) +

  labs(x = NULL, y = "Score range: 0 - 40",

  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    legend.position    = "bottom",
    strip.text         = element_blank(),
    plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0),
    axis.title.y       = element_text(size = 9, colour = "grey30"),
    plot.title.position = "plot"
```

```{r fig6_panelC}
fig6_panelC_df <- bind_rows(
  emm_to_bars_both_ci(phq_stfu_emm_rbst,     "Pooled",  "3m FU"),
  emm_to_bars_both_ci(phq_enl_emm_rbst,      "Pooled",  "20m FU"),
  emm_to_bars_both_ci(phq_hst_stfu_emm_rbst, "Host",    "3m FU"),
  emm_to_bars_both_ci(phq_hst_enl_emm_rbst,  "Host",    "20m FU"),
  emm_to_bars_both_ci(phq_ref_stfu_emm_rbst, "Refugee", "3m FU"),
  emm_to_bars_both_ci(phq_ref_enl_emm_rbst,  "Refugee", "20m FU")
) %>%
  mutate(
    sample    = factor(sample,    levels = c("Pooled", "Host", "Refugee")),
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = c("3m FU", "20m FU")),
    bar_fill  = factor(case_when(
      condition == "Control"     ~ "Control",
      timepoint == "3m FU"  ~ "Group Therapy (3m FU)",
      timepoint == "20m FU" ~ "Group Therapy (20m FU)"
    ),
    levels = c("Control",
               "Group Therapy (3m FU)",
               "Group Therapy (20m FU)"))
  )

fig6_panelC <-
  ggplot(fig6_panelC_df,
         aes(x = timepoint, y = y, fill = bar_fill, group = condition)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4, colour = "grey40") +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7,
           colour = "black", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci_lo, ymax = ci_hi),
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
                width = 0.18, linewidth = 0.5, colour = "black") +
  geom_text(data = ~ dplyr::filter(.x, condition == "Group Therapy"),
            aes(y = ci_hi, label = sig_sign(p_te)),
            vjust = -0.5, size = 5, colour = "black", show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ sample, ncol = 3) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 3, 6, 9)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 9)) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Control"                = "grey70",
               "Group Therapy (3m FU)"  = "steelblue1",
               "Group Therapy (20m FU)" = "dodgerblue4"),
    labels = c("Control"                = "Graduation control",
               "Group Therapy (3m FU)"  = "Group therapy (3m FU)",
               "Group Therapy (20m FU)" = "Group therapy (20m FU)"),
    name = NULL
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Score range: 0 - 27",
       title = "Depressive Symptoms (PHQ-9)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    legend.position    = "bottom",
    strip.text         = element_blank(),
    plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0),
    axis.title.y       = element_text(size = 10, colour = "grey30"),
    plot.title.position = "plot"
  )
```

## Stacked Figure

```{r fig6_stacked}
fig6 <-
  ((strip_caption(fig6_panelA) + guides(fill = "none")) /
   strip_caption(fig6_panelB) /
   strip_caption(fig6_panelC) /
   strip_caption(fig6_panelD)) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position   = "right",
        # compact the legend so the plot area itself gets more width
        legend.key.size   = unit(0.9, "lines"),
        legend.text       = element_text(size = 9),
        legend.margin     = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
        legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
        legend.spacing.y  = unit(0.15, "lines"),
        # Extra vertical padding between stacked panels (bump `t`/`b` to widen).
        plot.margin       = margin(t = 8, r = 4, b = 8, l = 4, unit = "pt"))

fig6
```

# Figure 4 - Treatment Effect on Primary Outcomes

## psych_distress_index

### Hosts: overall and by baseline distress level
```{r fig6_distress_host_models, include = FALSE}
# Distress g_t*dep interaction host models. Main-effect host models
# (psyInd_hst_stfu_lm_rbst / psyInd_hst_enl_lm_rbst) already exist from
# fig6_panelA_models above — reused directly in the plot chunks below.
psyInd_dep_hst_stfu_lm_rbst <-
  lm_robust(psych_distress_index ~ g_t*dep + kessler_6_bsl +
              female_head + someprimary_head +
              somesecondary_head + hhsize + coh1_holdout + factor(c2_vil_clus_id),
            se_type = "HC1",
            data = C2TB_stfu_wins %>% filter(refugee == 0))

psyInd_dep_hst_enl_lm_rbst <-
  lm_robust(psych_distress_index ~ g_t*dep + kessler_6_bsl +
              female_head + someprimary_head +
              somesecondary_head + hhsize + coh1_holdout + factor(c2_vil_clus_id),
            se_type = "HC1",
            data = C2TB_enl_wins %>% filter(refugee == 0))

psyInd_dep_hst_stfu_emm_rbst <-
  emmeans(psyInd_dep_hst_stfu_lm_rbst, ~ g_t | dep,
          at = list(g_t = c(0, 1), dep = c(0, 1)))
psyInd_dep_hst_enl_emm_rbst  <-
  emmeans(psyInd_dep_hst_enl_lm_rbst,  ~ g_t | dep,
          at = list(g_t = c(0, 1), dep = c(0, 1)))
```

```{r fig6_distress_host}
fig6_distress_host_df <- bind_rows(
  emm_to_te(psyInd_hst_stfu_emm_rbst, "Host", "3m FU") %>%

  emm_to_te(psyInd_hst_enl_emm_rbst,  "Host", "20m FU") %>%
    mutate(distress = "Overall"),
  emm_to_te_by_dep(psyInd_dep_hst_stfu_emm_rbst, "Host", "3m FU") %>%
    mutate(distress = as.character(dep_bsl)) %>% select(-dep_bsl),
  emm_to_te_by_dep(psyInd_dep_hst_enl_emm_rbst,  "Host", "20m FU") %>%
    mutate(distress = as.character(dep_bsl)) %>% select(-dep_bsl)
) %>%
  mutate(
    timepoint = factor(timepoint, levels = c("3m FU", "20m FU")),
    distress  = factor(distress,
                       levels = c("Overall", "High", "Low"),
                       labels = c("Averaged effect",
                                  "Higher baseline distress",
                                  "Lower baseline distress"))
  )

fig6_distress_host <-
  ggplot(fig6_distress_host_df, aes(x = timepoint, y = y,
                                     fill = timepoint, color = timepoint)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4, colour = "grey40") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-.14, .35), breaks = seq(-.1,.3,.1)) +

  geom_text(aes(y = ci_hi, label = sig_sign(p)),
            vjust = -0.6, size = 5, colour = "black", show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ distress, ncol = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("3m FU"  = "steelblue1", "20m FU" = "dodgerblue4"),
    name   = NULL
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("3m FU"  = "steelblue1", "20m FU" = "dodgerblue4"),
    name   = NULL
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Effect size \n(std. to Mean and SD of refugee Graduation control)",
       title = "Hosts: treatment effect on psychological distress index") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x  = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor    = element_blank(),
    legend.position     = "bottom",
    strip.text          = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title          = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0),
    axis.title.y       = element_text(size = 9, colour = "grey20"),

  )
```

```{r fig6_fcs_ref}
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x  = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor    = element_blank(),
    legend.position     = "bottom",
    strip.text          = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title          = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0),
    axis.title.y       = element_text(size = 10, colour = "grey20"),
    plot.title.position = "plot"
  )

fig6_fcs_ref
```

## Stacked Figure

```{r fig6_stacked}
# 3 x 2 grid: three outcome rows (distress, well-being, econ) x two sample
# columns (Hosts | Refugees). Each cell is a full panel with three facets:
# averaged effect, high baseline distress, low baseline distress.
#
# Column headers "Hosts" / "Refugees" sit above the top row. Facet strips
# (averaged / high / low) are kept on the TOP row (distress) only so they
# aren't repeated for wellbeing and econ below. Each panel's own title
# (e.g. "Hosts: treatment effect on ...") is suppressed since the column
# header + facet strips + per-panel y-axis label already identify it.
# User-edited y-axis labels are preserved on every cell.
#
# FCS panels (fig6_fcs_host / fig6_fcs_ref) and fcs_ylim are still defined
# above and callable on their own, but intentionally excluded from this
# stacked composition.

# Force both host and refugee cells in the same outcome row to share the SAME
# y-axis: the outer `coord_cartesian` sets the visible range; the inner
# `scale_y_continuous` overrides any hard-coded scale_y_continuous inside the
# individual panels (e.g. fig6_distress_host has one) so tick marks match too.
# `suppressMessages` silences ggplot's "Scale for y is already present" note
# from the intentional replacement.
apply_ylim <- function(p, ylim, breaks = waiver()) {
  suppressMessages(
    p + scale_y_continuous(breaks = breaks) +
        coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim)
  )
}
strip_off  <- function(p) p + theme(strip.text = element_blank())

# Column-header helper: a small ggplot with centered bold text.
col_header <- function(txt) {
  ggplot() +
    annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = txt,
             hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5, fontface = "bold", size = 6) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(plot.margin = margin(t = 4, b = 0, l = 0, r = 0, unit = "pt"))
}

hosts_col_hdr    <- col_header("Hosts")
refugees_col_hdr <- col_header("Refugees")

# Row-header helper: left-aligned bold text, spans BOTH columns via the layout
# design string below (so hosts and refugees share the same outcome label).
row_header <- function(txt) {
  ggplot() +
    annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0.5, label = txt,
             hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, fontface = "bold", size = 5.4) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(plot.margin = margin(t = 6, b = 2, l = 6, r = 0, unit = "pt"))
}

distress_row_hdr  <- row_header("Psychological distress index")
wellbeing_row_hdr <- row_header("Psychological well-being index")
econ_row_hdr      <- row_header("Economic activity index")

# ─── Shared y-axis within each outcome row ───
distress_ylim <- {
  ys <- c(fig6_distress_host_df$ci_lo, fig6_distress_host_df$ci_hi,
          fig6_distress_ref_df$ci_lo,  fig6_distress_ref_df$ci_hi)
  r  <- range(ys, na.rm = TRUE)
  # Extra top-side headroom so the sig sign sits above the tallest errorbar.
  r + c(-0.08, 0.18) * diff(r)
}
wellbeing_ylim <- {
  ys <- c(fig6_host_df$ci_lo, fig6_host_df$ci_hi,
          fig6_ref_df$ci_lo,  fig6_ref_df$ci_hi)
  r  <- range(ys, na.rm = TRUE)
  r + c(-1, 1) * 0.08 * diff(r)
}
econ_ylim <- {
  ys <- c(fig6_host_df$ci_lo, fig6_host_df$ci_hi,
          fig6_ref_df$ci_lo,  fig6_ref_df$ci_hi)
  r  <- range(ys, na.rm = TRUE)
  r + c(-1, 1) * 0.08 * diff(r)
}
# Kept in case FCS is re-added to the stack later.
fcs_ylim <- {
  ys <- c(fig6_fcs_host_df$ci_lo, fig6_fcs_host_df$ci_hi,
          fig6_fcs_ref_df$ci_lo,  fig6_fcs_ref_df$ci_hi)
  r  <- range(ys, na.rm = TRUE)
  r + c(-0.08, 0.18) * diff(r)
}

# Drop each panel's own title (column headers now identify Host / Refugee).
# Everything else — user-edited y-axis labels, facet strips (unless stripped),
# scales — is preserved.
no_title <- function(p) p + labs(title = NULL) +
  theme(plot.title = element_blank())

# Compute one set of pretty breaks per outcome row so host and refugee share
# identical tick marks (not just an identical visible range).
distress_breaks  <- pretty(distress_ylim,  n = 5)
wellbeing_breaks <- pretty(wellbeing_ylim, n = 5)
econ_breaks      <- pretty(econ_ylim,      n = 5)

# ─── Six cells: 3 outcomes x 2 samples ───
# Row 1 (distress) keeps facet strips on BOTH columns. Rows 2 & 3 strip them
# so the "averaged / high / low" labels aren't repeated three times.
# Each row passes the same (ylim, breaks) to both host and refugee cells so
# their y-axes are byte-identical.
distress_hst_cell  <- apply_ylim(no_title(fig6_distress_host),   distress_ylim,  distress_breaks)
distress_ref_cell  <- apply_ylim(no_title(fig6_distress_ref),    distress_ylim,  distress_breaks)

wellbeing_hst_cell <- apply_ylim(no_title(strip_off(fig6_host)), wellbeing_ylim, wellbeing_breaks)
wellbeing_ref_cell <- apply_ylim(no_title(strip_off(fig6_ref)),  wellbeing_ylim, wellbeing_breaks)

econ_hst_cell      <- apply_ylim(no_title(strip_off(fig6_host)), econ_ylim,      econ_breaks)
econ_ref_cell      <- apply_ylim(no_title(strip_off(fig6_ref)),  econ_ylim,      econ_breaks)

# ─── Compose: 7-row layout with per-outcome row headers spanning both cols ───
# `design` uses one letter per plot; repeated letters across cells make that
# plot span. Order of plot objects added below MUST match A..K in the design.
#
#   AB  hosts_col_hdr | refugees_col_hdr
#   CC  distress outcome label (spans both cols)
#   DE  distress cells (host | refugee)
#   FF  wellbeing outcome label
#   GH  wellbeing cells
#   II  econ outcome label
#   JK  econ cells
fig6_design <- "
AB
CC
DE
FF
GH
II
JK
"

fig6 <-
  (hosts_col_hdr      + refugees_col_hdr    +   # A, B
   distress_row_hdr   +                          # C
   distress_hst_cell  + distress_ref_cell   +   # D, E
   wellbeing_row_hdr  +                          # F
   wellbeing_hst_cell + wellbeing_ref_cell  +   # G, H
   econ_row_hdr       +                          # I
   econ_hst_cell      + econ_ref_cell) +        # J, K
  plot_layout(design  = fig6_design,
              guides  = "collect",
              heights = c(0.10, 0.08, 1,
                                0.08, 1,
                                0.08, 1)) &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

fig6
```



# Figure 5 - Kessler 6 timeline

Adjusting `kessler_6_bsl` at sub-sample mean

```{r fig5gc_centering}
# Group-mean centering of `kessler_6_bsl` used by both the hosts and refugees
# model chunks below. Two centered versions are added:
#   * `kessler_6_bsl_ref_gc`    — centered within refugee status (used by the
#                                  pooled-across-distress models).
#   * `kessler_6_bsl_refDep_gc` — centered within refugee × dep cell (used by
#                                  the by-baseline-distress interaction models).
# Both centerings are applied to STFU and endline datasets.

C2TB_stfu_wins <-
  C2TB_stfu_wins %>%
  group_by(refugee) %>%
  mutate(kessler_6_bsl_ref_gc = kessler_6_bsl - mean(kessler_6_bsl, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(refugee, dep) %>%
  mutate(kessler_6_bsl_refDep_gc = kessler_6_bsl - mean(kessler_6_bsl, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

C2TB_enl_wins <-
  C2TB_enl_wins %>%
  group_by(refugee) %>%
  mutate(kessler_6_bsl_ref_gc = kessler_6_bsl - mean(kessler_6_bsl, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(refugee, dep) %>%
  mutate(kessler_6_bsl_refDep_gc = kessler_6_bsl - mean(kessler_6_bsl, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()
```

## Hosts: overall and by baseline distress level

Pooled-across-distress models adjust for `kessler_6_bsl` at the host mean
(`kessler_6_bsl_ref_gc = 0`). By-baseline-distress interaction models adjust
for `kessler_6_bsl` at the host × dep cell mean (`kessler_6_bsl_refDep_gc = 0`).

```{r fig5gc_host_models}
# ─── Hosts, pooled across distress ─────────────────────────────────────────
ksl6_hst_bsl_lm_brst <-
  lm_robust(kessler_6_bsl ~ g_t + female_head + someprimary_head +
              somesecondary_head + hhsize + coh1_holdout + factor(c2_vil_clus_id),
            se_type = "HC1",
            data = C2TB_bsl %>% filter(refugee == 0))

ksl6_hst_stfu_lm_brst2 <-
  lm_robust(kessler_6 ~ g_t + kessler_6_bsl_ref_gc +
              female_head + someprimary_head +
              somesecondary_head + hhsize + coh1_holdout + factor(c2_vil_clus_id),
            se_type = "HC1",
            data = C2TB_stfu_wins %>% filter(refugee == 0))

ksl6_hst_enl_lm_brst2 <-
  lm_robust(kessler_6 ~ g_t + kessler_6_bsl_ref_gc +
              female_head + someprimary_head +
              somesecondary_head + hhsize + coh1_holdout + factor(c2_vil_clus_id),
            se_type = "HC1",
            data = C2TB_enl_wins %>% filter(refugee == 0))

# ─── Hosts, by baseline distress ───────────────────────────────────────────
ksl6_dep_hst_bsl_lm_brst <-
  lm_robust(kessler_6_bsl ~ g_t*dep + female_head + someprimary_head +
              somesecondary_head + hhsize + coh1_holdout + factor(c2_vil_clus_id),
            se_type = "HC1",
            data = C2TB_bsl %>% filter(refugee == 0))

ksl6_dep_hst_stfu_lm_brst2 <-
  lm_robust(kessler_6 ~ g_t*dep + kessler_6_bsl_refDep_gc +
              female_head + someprimary_head +
              somesecondary_head + hhsize + coh1_holdout + factor(c2_vil_clus_id),
            se_type = "HC1",
            data = C2TB_stfu_wins %>% filter(refugee == 0))

ksl6_dep_hst_enl_lm_brst2 <-
  lm_robust(kessler_6 ~ g_t*dep + kessler_6_bsl_refDep_gc +
              female_head + someprimary_head +
              somesecondary_head + hhsize + coh1_holdout + factor(c2_vil_clus_id),
            se_type = "HC1",
            data = C2TB_enl_wins %>% filter(refugee == 0))

# ─── Emmeans ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ksl6_hst_bsl_emm_brst    <-
  emmeans(ksl6_hst_bsl_lm_brst,    ~ g_t,
          at = list(g_t = c(0, 1)))
ksl6_hst_stfu_emm_brst2  <-
  emmeans(ksl6_hst_stfu_lm_brst2,  ~ g_t,
          at = list(g_t = c(0, 1), kessler_6_bsl_ref_gc = 0))
ksl6_hst_enl_emm_brst2   <-
  emmeans(ksl6_hst_enl_lm_brst2,   ~ g_t,
          at = list(g_t = c(0, 1), kessler_6_bsl_ref_gc = 0))

ksl6_dep_hst_bsl_emm_brst   <-
  emmeans(ksl6_dep_hst_bsl_lm_brst,   ~ dep|g_t,
          at = list(g_t = c(0, 1), dep = c(0, 1)))
ksl6_dep_hst_stfu_emm_brst2 <-
  emmeans(ksl6_dep_hst_stfu_lm_brst2, ~ dep|g_t,
          at = list(g_t = c(0, 1), dep = c(0, 1),
                    kessler_6_bsl_refDep_gc = 0))
ksl6_dep_hst_enl_emm_brst2  <-
  emmeans(ksl6_dep_hst_enl_lm_brst2,  ~ dep|g_t,
          at = list(g_t = c(0, 1), dep = c(0, 1),
                    kessler_6_bsl_refDep_gc = 0))
```

```{r fig5gc_host}
# Assemble the host-only long dataframe used by both the standalone host
# plot below AND the stacked (1 × 4) figure further down.
fig5_host_df <- bind_rows(
  # pooled across distress
  emm_to_k6_line_nodep_df(ksl6_hst_bsl_emm_brst,   "Baseline")    %>%
    mutate(distress = "Pooled"),
  emm_to_k6_line_nodep_df(ksl6_hst_stfu_emm_brst2, "3m FU")  %>%
    mutate(distress = "Pooled"),
  emm_to_k6_line_nodep_df(ksl6_hst_enl_emm_brst2,  "20m FU") %>%
    mutate(distress = "Pooled"),
  # by baseline distress
  emm_to_k6_line_df(ksl6_dep_hst_bsl_emm_brst,     "Baseline")    %>%
    mutate(distress = as.character(dep_bsl)),
  emm_to_k6_line_df(ksl6_dep_hst_stfu_emm_brst2,   "3m FU")  %>%
    mutate(distress = as.character(dep_bsl)),
  emm_to_k6_line_df(ksl6_dep_hst_enl_emm_brst2,    "20m FU") %>%
    mutate(distress = as.character(dep_bsl))
) %>%
  mutate(
    sample     = "Host",
    time_point = factor(time_point,
                        levels = c("Baseline", "3m FU", "20m FU")),
    distress   = factor(distress, levels = c("Pooled", "High", "Low")),
    facet      = factor(
      if_else(distress == "Pooled",
              "Host: pooled across distress",
              "Host: by baseline distress"),
      levels = c("Host: pooled across distress",
                 "Host: by baseline distress")
    )
  )

fig5_host_plot <-
  ggplot(fig5_host_df,
         aes(x = time_point, y = y,
             colour   = condition,
             linetype = distress,
             group    = interaction(condition, distress))) +
  geom_line(position = position_dodge(width = 0.15), linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.15), size = 2.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = if_else(condition == "Group Therapy",
                                sig_sign(p_te), "")),
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.15),
            vjust = -1.0, size = 5, colour = "black",
            show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ facet, ncol = 2) +
  # `values` keys must match the actual `condition` levels in the data
  # ("Control" / "Group Therapy"). Use `labels` to change what shows in the
  # legend without breaking the colour mapping.
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c("Control"       = "grey60",
               "Group Therapy" = "steelblue"),
    labels = c("Control"       = "Graduation control",
               "Group Therapy" = "Group therapy"),
    name   = NULL
  ) +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c("Pooled" = "solid",
               "High"   = "longdash",
               "Low"    = "dotted"),
    labels = c("Pooled" = "Average across baseline distress level",
               "High"   = "Higher baseline distress",
               "Low"    = "Lower baseline distress"),
    name = NULL, drop = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL,
       title = "Hosts: Kessler-6 timeline") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.x  = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor    = element_blank(),
    legend.position     = "bottom",
    strip.text          = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title          = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0),
    plot.title.position = "plot"
  )

fig5_host_plot
```

```{r fig5gc_ref}
    plot.title.position = "plot"
  )

fig5_ref_plot
```

## Stacked figure
```{r fig5gc_stacked, fig.width = 14, fig.height = 5}
# 1-row layout with a visual gap between samples:
#   Hosts (pooled | by baseline distress level)  —  Refugees (pooled | by baseline distress level)
# Achieved via patchwork so each half carries a left-flushed "Hosts"/"Refugees"
# header above its two facet columns; the facet strips are trimmed to just
# "pooled" / "by baseline distress level".

trim_facet <- as_labeller(function(x) {
  x <- sub("^(Host|Refugee): ", "", x)
  x <- sub("^pooled across distress$", "Average effect", x)
  x <- sub("^by baseline distress$",   "By baseline distress level", x)
  x
})

# Shared y-limits across all four panels so hosts and refugees stay comparable.
# K6 items are 0-4 (Matt shifts the raw Likert 1-5 to 0-4 in cleaning), so the
# K6 total ranges 0-24. Y-axis label surfaces that context.

fig5_host_row <-
  fig5_host_plot +
  facet_wrap(~ facet, ncol = 2, labeller = trim_facet) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(1.5,12), breaks = seq(2,12,2)) +
  labs(title = "Hosts", y = "Score range: 0 - 24") +
  theme(plot.title          = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0),
        plot.title.position = "plot",
        axis.title.y        = element_text(size = 9, colour = "grey30"))

fig5_ref_row <-
  fig5_ref_plot +
  facet_wrap(~ facet, ncol = 2, labeller = trim_facet) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(1.5,12), breaks = seq(2,12,2)) +
  labs(title = "Refugees", y = "Score range: 0 - 24") +
  theme(plot.title          = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0),
        plot.title.position = "plot",
        axis.title.y        = element_text(size = 9, colour = "grey30"))

fig5gc <-
  (fig5_host_row | plot_spacer() | fig5_ref_row) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(2, 0.15, 2), guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Kessler-6 temporal trajectory by baseline distress levels"
  ) &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0))

fig5gc
```


# Figure 6 - Potential Mechanism for Group Therapy

```{r fig6_stfu_mech_vars}
stfu_mech_vars <-
  C2TB_stfu_wins %>%
  select(optimism_z, soc_worth_status_fz,
         self_efficacy_z,
         communication_temp_z,
         #loneliness_z, closeness_z,
         #social_belonging_z,
         social_inclusion_z,
         meta_cognitive_z,
         grit_index_z,
         self_control_z) %>%
  names()

# Shared display labels for the 18 mechanism z-scores; keys MUST match the
# variable names in `stfu_mech_vars`. Reused by both Panel A and Panel B.
mech_labels <- c(
  optimism_z            = "Optimistic future expectations",
  soc_worth_status_fz   = "Social worth",
  self_efficacy_z       = "Self efficacy",
  communication_temp_z  = "Spousal communication",
  #loneliness_z          = "Loneliness (reverse coded)",
  meta_cognitive_z      = "Meta-cognitive coping",
  #closeness_z           = "Interpersonal closeness",
  social_inclusion_z    = "Social inclusion",
  grit_index_z          = "Grit",
  self_control_z        = "Self control"
)

stopifnot(setequal(names(mech_labels), stfu_mech_vars))

C2TB_stfu_wins %>%
  select(g_t, refugee, stfu_mech_vars) %>%
  describeBy(group = c("g_t", "refugee"))

# emmeans(psyInd_dep_hst_stfu_lm_rbst, ~ g_t | dep,
#           at = list(g_t = c(0, 1), dep = c(0, 1))) %>%
#   contrast(method = list("gipt - no gipt" = c(-1,1)))
# 
# emmeans(psyInd_dep_hst_stfu_lm_rbst, ~ g_t,
#           at = list(g_t = c(0, 1))) %>%
#   contrast(method = list("gipt - no gipt" = c(-1,1)))
```

```{r fig6_fit_all}
# Fit Panel A (mech ~ g_t) and Panel B (psych_distress_index_z ~ mech) coef
# tibbles for each of the four sub-samples up front, then derive shared
# x-axis limits + breaks so panels are directly comparable across sub-samples.
fig6_subsamples <- list(
  hostDep   = list(
    A = C2TB_stfu_wins %>% filter(refugee == 0, dep == 1),
    #B = C2TB_stfu_wins %>% filter(refugee == 0, dep == 1, g_t == 1),
    label = "high baseline distress hosts at 3m FU"),
  hostNodep = list(
    A = C2TB_stfu_wins %>% filter(refugee == 0, dep == 0),
    #B = C2TB_stfu_wins %>% filter(refugee == 0, dep == 0, g_t == 1),
    label = "low baseline distress hosts at 3m FU"),
  refDep    = list(
    A = C2TB_stfu_wins %>% filter(refugee == 1, dep == 1),
    #B = C2TB_stfu_wins %>% filter(refugee == 1, dep == 1, g_t == 1),
    label = "high baseline distress refugees at 3m FU"),
  refNodep  = list(
    A = C2TB_stfu_wins %>% filter(refugee == 1, dep == 0),
    #B = C2TB_stfu_wins %>% filter(refugee == 1, dep == 0, g_t == 1),
    label = "low baseline distress refugees at 3m FU")
)

fig6_coefs <- lapply(fig6_subsamples, function(sub) {
  list(
    A = run_mech_models(stfu_mech_vars, sub$A, label = sub$label)
    # B = run_mech_predictors(stfu_mech_vars, sub$B,
    #                         outcome = "psych_distress_index",
    #                         label   = paste(sub$label, "— GIPT only"))
  )
})

# Joint x-axis range across sub-samples (include 0, pad for label room),
# then a nice break sequence via pretty().
.panelA_ci <- do.call(rbind, lapply(fig6_coefs, function(x) x$A[, c("ci_low", "ci_high")]))
#.panelB_ci <- do.call(rbind, lapply(fig6_coefs, function(x) x$B[, c("ci_low", "ci_high")]))

panelA_range <- range(c(.panelA_ci$ci_low, .panelA_ci$ci_high, 0))
#panelB_range <- range(c(.panelB_ci$ci_low, .panelB_ci$ci_high, 0))

panelA_xlim   <- panelA_range + 0.20 * diff(panelA_range) * c(-1, 1)
#panelB_xlim   <- panelB_range + 0.10 * diff(panelB_range) * c(-1, 1)

panelA_breaks <- pretty(panelA_xlim, n = 5)
#panelB_breaks <- pretty(panelB_xlim, n = 5)
```

## Hosts high baseline distress
```{r fig6_host_dep}
stfu_host_dep_mech_coef <- fig6_coefs$hostDep$A

MECH_COL <- "steelblue1"   # one hue; single series needs no legend

stfu_host_dep_mech_dfA <- stfu_host_dep_mech_coef %>%
  mutate(
    label   = unname(mech_labels[dv]),
    stars   = case_when(p < .01 ~ "**", p < .05 ~ "*", p < .10 ~ "<sup>†</sup>", TRUE ~ ""),
    lab_txt = paste0(sprintf("%.2f", estimate), stars),
    # Always anchor the coefficient label at the right end of the errorbar
    # and push it just outside via a negative hjust, so every label sits to
    # the right of its point regardless of sign.
    lab_x   = ci_high,
    lab_h   = -0.25
  ) %>%
  mutate(label = fct_reorder(label, abs(estimate)))

stfu_host_dep_mech <-
  ggplot(stfu_host_dep_mech_dfA, aes(x = estimate, y = label)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4, colour = "grey55") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = ci_low, xmax = ci_high),
                height = 0.20, linewidth = 0.7,
                colour = scales::alpha(MECH_COL, 0.45), orientation = "y") +
  geom_point(size = 3.2, colour = MECH_COL) +
  geom_richtext(aes(x = lab_x, label = lab_txt, hjust = lab_h),
                size = 3.4, colour = "grey20",
                fill = NA, label.colour = NA) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = panelA_xlim, breaks = panelA_breaks,
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))) +
  labs(x = "Effect size",
       y = NULL,
       title = "Host participants with higher baseline distress") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "grey92", linewidth = 0.3),
    axis.text.y        = element_text(colour = "grey15"),
    plot.title.position = "plot"
  )

stfu_host_dep_mech
```

# Figure 7 - Correlates to Psych Distress
```{r fig7_overall_predictors}
# Panel B analogue on the entire STFU sample: shows how strongly each
# psychosocial mechanism variable correlates with psychological distress at
# 3m FU, holding baseline Kessler-6 constant. No subgroup or GIPT filter.
stfu_overall_mech_coef <-
  run_mech_predictors(stfu_mech_vars, C2TB_stfu_wins,
                      outcome = "psych_distress_index",
                      label   = "entire sample at 3m FU")

MECH_COL <- "steelblue1"

fig7_overall_df <- stfu_overall_mech_coef %>%
  mutate(
    label   = unname(mech_labels[dv]),
    stars   = case_when(p < .001 ~ "***",
                        p < .01  ~ "**",
                        p < .05  ~ "*",
                        p < .10  ~ "<sup>†</sup>",
                        TRUE     ~ ""),
    lab_txt = paste0(sprintf("%.2f", estimate), stars),
    # Always anchor the coefficient label at the right end of the errorbar
    # and push it just outside via a negative hjust, regardless of sign, so
    # every label sits to the right of its point and error bar.
    lab_x   = ci_high,
    lab_h   = -0.25
  ) %>%
  mutate(label = fct_reorder(label, abs(estimate)))

stopifnot(!any(is.na(fig7_overall_df$label)))

fig7_overall_predictors <-
  ggplot(fig7_overall_df, aes(x = estimate, y = label)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.4, colour = "grey55") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = ci_low, xmax = ci_high),
                height = 0.20, linewidth = 0.7,
                colour = scales::alpha(MECH_COL, 0.45), orientation = "y") +
  geom_point(size = 3.2, colour = MECH_COL) +
  geom_richtext(aes(x = lab_x, label = lab_txt, hjust = lab_h),
                size = 3.4, colour = "grey20",
                fill = NA, label.colour = NA) +
  # Extra right-side padding so the always-right coefficient labels have room
  # to sit outside the widest errorbar without being clipped.
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.06, 0.14))) +
  labs(x = "Effect size\n(std. to Means and SDs of refugee Graduation control group)",
       y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y  = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor    = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x  = element_line(colour = "grey92", linewidth = 0.3),
    axis.text.y         = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title.x        = element_text(size = 11),
    plot.title.position = "plot"
  )

fig7_overall_predictors
```
